timeline.title: Your flight plan.
timeline.description: From your first bold idea to a world of possibilities. Explore every stage of the mission.
timeline.instructions: Choose a checkpoint, swipe the briefing, or use the arrow keys to travel.

launch.title: Mission Launch: Registration Opens
launch.description: Your mission begins here. Enlist as an individual explorer or register with your crew. Space Apps Giza welcomes university and school students, researchers, young professionals, and curious minds ready to turn bold ideas into real-world solutions.

bootcamp.title: Mission Training: The Bootcamp
bootcamp.description: One intensive day to prepare for the journey ahead. Take part in workshops and expert sessions, explore partner booths, meet fellow innovators, and assemble your crew. Arrive solo and get ready to build with a team.

training.title: Flight Preparation: Weekly Online Sessions
training.description: Your training continues beyond the bootcamp. Join weekly online sessions covering technical topics, working with NASA’s open data, and preparing your team for the challenges of a 48-hour build.

hackathon.title: Mission Control: The 48-Hour Hackathon
hackathon.description: Two days to turn ideas into working solutions. Build with your crew, learn from mentors, attend workshops, and push your concept forward. The mission culminates in submissions, judging by specialists, and a closing ceremony where the winners are announced.

global.title: Beyond Earth: Global Judging
global.description: For projects nominated from Cairo, the journey can continue beyond the local event to NASA’s global judging stage. Cairo teams have earned nominations more than 40 times and achieved global wins in 2024 and 2025.

deck.title: YOUR MISSION STARTS HERE.
deck.description: Explore real NASA challenges, discover what inspires you, and find the mission you want to take on.
deck.instructions: Swipe or use arrow keys to explore
